records.title: Disha Meetings in Daman and Diu
details: e to f: As per DISHA guidelines, the proceedings of the DISHA meetings should be issued within 10 days of the meeting and it should be immediately uploaded on the 'Meeting Reporting Portal' (https:/erp.disha.gov.in), a portal developed by Ministry of Rural Development to support the operations of DISHA. Proceedings of the DISHA meetings held in Daman and Diu Districts have not yet been uploaded on the 'Meeting Report Portal'
